transcript: My child, listen closely. A migraine is not an attack on you. It is your body trying to speak when the head tightens, when the light hurts your eyes. This is a signal that the nervous system is tired, the liver is overloaded, and your neck carries too much tension. In the West, they silence the pain. But when you silence the messenger, the message only grows louder. Let me teach you a simple ritual. First, place a warm towel on the back of your neck. Feel how the pressure softens. Second, press this point between your thumb and index finger. We call it the Heaven's Gate. Hold it for 30 seconds. Third, drink lemon balm tea. It calms the nerves and relaxes the blood vessels that cause the migraine. And if you want stronger, quicker relief, use the lemon balm extract just a few drops. And finally, breathe slow. Four seconds in, six seconds out. Allow the pain to melt as your body returns to peace. My child, a migraine is not your enemy. It is your guide. When you listen, the healing begins.
